profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Ambitious Software Engineer with experience in full stack development, prototype design, and data modeling. Creative mindset with an immense passion for innovation and utilizing technology to positively impact the community and the industry. Excited about opportunities to contribute to a great team culture, in addition to expanding my technical prowess and delivering world class content.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · Front-end Engineering · Firebase · User Experience (UX) · Front-End Development · Front-end Coding · SASS

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated the previously external blog into the company’s main web app using Next.js and static asset pipelines, improving load times and content discoverability
• Built and deployed a real-time Metrics Dashboard that visualized platform usage (e.g., queries per second), enabling customers to track performance
• Implemented enhancements to Chat UI and function calling to support smoother interactions
• Modernized legacy pages and user flows with React best practices, driving measurable improvements in usability and engagement
positions.insights: Skills: Data Modeling · SQL · React.js · Client Side · Data Models · Front-end Engineering · User Experience (UX) · Front-End Development · Next.js · Front-end Coding · TypeScript

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a playlist draft-saving feature that preserved curator work across sessions, eliminating a major pain point in the music curation workflow.
• Built GraphQL endpoints and client logic to support playlist management, improving API reliability and response times.
• Partnered with music curators and internal stakeholders to introduce a new drafts tab, enabling more iterative playlist creation and higher curator throughput.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · SQL · React.js · Client Side · Data Models · Node.js · Front-end Engineering · Front-End Development · Apollo GraphQL · Front-end Coding · GraphQL · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development on a centralized dependency management tool used by the Online Store Engineering org to improve visibility into services and application dependencies.
• Built a dashboard for tracking iterative software releases, enabling cross-functional teams to stay aligned and resolve blockers early in the OS release process.
• Collaborated across engineering, QA, and PM teams to modernize legacy AngularJS codebases
positions.insights: Skills: Data Modeling · SQL · Client Side · Data Models · Front-end Engineering · User Experience (UX) · AngularJS · Redux.js · Front-End Development · Front-end Coding

positions.title: Intelligent Tutoring Systems Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Expanded proficiency in user-interface technologies, databases, concept maps, and mobile applications 
•	Worked on undergraduate team to develop an online interactive system that enhances student learning by use of tutor-based interactions such as practice questions, books, notes, tests, and other web resources
•	Enhanced the system to function effectively on all mobile platforms to further improve user experience

positions.title: Front End Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Developed and deployed a web application designed to improve visibility and functionality of internal Nike events using Javascript, jQuery, XML, SAPUI5, and other HTML5+ technologies.
• Collaborated on a team as architect and developer to win  the Nike Technology Intern Hackathon by programming an Amazon Alexa assistant to provide employees with information on shuttle scheduling, cafeteria menus, gym classes, and more.
positions.insights: Skills: Client Side · Front-end Engineering · Front-End Development · Front-end Coding

positions.title: Web UI Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Collaborated in agile-based software environment to enhance internal applications responsible for media asset management, file-based video production, and editorial systems
•	Designed and implemented a web form to help content distributors generate XML documents for submitted content using  Bootstrap, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, and other HTML5+ technologies
•	Developed knowledge of inter-relationships between complex enterprise production systems
positions.insights: Skills: Client Side · Front-end Engineering · Front-End Development · Front-end Coding

positions.title: Information Security Architecture & Operations Intern
positions.description:
• Enhanced security team’s accomplishments through planning and implementation of solutions
• Formulated system security reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends
• Developed information systems skills through interaction with operations, computer software, and databases

positions.title: Human Automations Lab Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Project focused on finding a way to keep patients motivated to do their physical therapy
• Developed a 3D arm robot and used Java to program tablet games to be played by the patients 
• Received successful and positive results upon tests on physical therapy patients

organizations.position: Treasurer and Social Chair · Nov 2014 - Present
organizations.description:
• Improved internal functioning with quantified oversight of all monetary involvement and strategic planning
• Implemented an economic system to enable the organization to finish the year with more financial flexibility than in recent years
• Bolstered campus popularity and organizational success by exceeding 100% increase in membership and participation through creative events and effective marketing
